brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed 16 Palestinians, including two women and a child, between November 12 and 15, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The deaths resulted from airstrikes, artillery shelling, and attacks on civilian vehicles and gatherings across multiple areas of the Gaza Strip. Thirteen Palestinians were killed during active operations, while medical sources attributed three additional deaths to the same period.

The killings coincided with continued Israeli demolition of residential structures throughout Gaza, compounding civilian losses and displacement across the territory.
